body:
Well I was trying THC gummies AGAIN to combat pain and again the same experience.
I started with two large gummies (20 mg each) and waited for about half an hour with no results.   I was told it could take up to two hours to see some results but being impatient I I popped 4 more (10 mg each) and sat down to wait and see what would happen.
About an hour in it hit me and it hit me hard.   I started feeling woozy and jumpy but that was only a minor thing.   Within minutes my whole body was covered in sweat from head to foot and I started shaking and running around from room to room to try and make the feeling go away.  I took a shower.   I ran my hands under a tap.   My vision started to blur and the room looked like it was filled with smoke.  My heart started to pound and then....I vomited.  The vomiting continued for about half an hour and the head spins kept on coming.   Luckily I was able to call a friend who sat it out with me until I felt better.   This seemed to go on for hours but in reality probably was only an hour and half total.
This has happened every time I've ingested edibles with this incident being the worst for the reason that I consumed so many gummies.   I also take anti depressants and am pretty sure that they must react with the THC.  I can think of no other reason as everyone else that eats these things feels GREAT.
